caseNameFull: Bohling v. Corsi, Commissioner, Division of Employment, Department of Labor of New York
attorneys: Merwin K. Hart, Jr. for appellant., Nathaniel Goldstein, Attorney General of New York, Wendell P. Brown, Solicitor General, and Francis R. Curran, Assistant Attorney General, for appellee.

opinions.text:
Appeal from the Court of Appeals of New York.

Per Curiam:

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed for the want of a substantial federal question.
